description: Capture a device screenshot and semantic UI tree, optionally preprocess the image with Sharp, run OCR with Tesseract when installed, and map recognized text to element bounds and elementRef values. Saves screenshot and JSON analysis under .androidmcp-framework/artifacts.

minConfidence.description: Minimum Tesseract OCR confidence from 0 to 100; defaults to 45.

projectPath.description: Project root for saved artifacts; defaults to the current working directory.

targetId.description: Target device ID; defaults to the active session target.

tesseractPath.description: Optional path to the Tesseract executable.

timeoutMs.description: OCR timeout in milliseconds; defaults to 15000.

name: analyze_screen_image
title: Analyze Screen Image
